subject.title: Feature: configurable bootstrap file injection order for prompt cache optimization

question: Should OpenClaw add a public config surface for bootstrap dynamic-file classification and/or full bootstrap file ordering, and what exact scope should that API have?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix would add durable prompt/config semantics with cache and upgrade behavior, which repository policy says needs maintainer product/API direction before implementation.

options.title: Add dynamic classification only
options.body: Introduce a narrow `bootstrapDynamicFiles`-style config that preserves existing default order while letting operators move volatile files below the cache boundary.

options.title: Add ordering plus dynamic files
options.body: Expose both ordering and dynamic classification, giving operators maximum control at the cost of a broader long-term prompt-shape API.

options.title: Fold into broader context design
options.body: Defer this issue behind the broader deterministic bootstrap/context or session-freeze work so one public contract covers volatility, tiering, and refresh behavior together.

recommendation.title: Add dynamic classification only
recommendation.body: Introduce a narrow `bootstrapDynamicFiles`-style config that preserves existing default order while letting operators move volatile files below the cache boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: The current stable/dynamic prompt-cache split and adjacent context-injection config work trace most directly to Vincent's merged history.
